known Unicorn defect: Unicorn implements BZHI with the wrong threshold, and it is not only the flag.  Intel: N := SRC2[7:0]; if N < 64 then DEST[63:N] := 0; CF := (N > 63).  Measured, Unicorn flips CF at N=63 (should be 64) AND keeps masking bit 63 for every N >= 64, returning 0x7fff... where the manual says DEST is copied unchanged as 0xffff....  Both the flag and the result are wrong, so the whole entry is quarantined rather than just CF.
